verdict: No source, apparatus, input, grading or provenance blocker.
review_scope: Actual README, starter, oracle, independent reference, grader, validator, final AUTHOR, input/history records, scientific/local reports and frozen provenance read. Existing numerical evidence inspected; no new scientific or model run.
physics: The stated complete zero-field cell free energy has a unique relaxed offset: its Hessian is positive with eigenvalues at least K. The source correctly solves this state and differentiates laboratory polarization P=-F s/det(F).

The material upper electrode measures conventional charge entering a face whose area and normal move. Its grounded weighting potential is material z divided by slab thickness; complete neutral cells give upper charge s3 per reference area and physical current ds3. The source instead evaluates minus instantaneous area vector dotted with dP, a coherent improper polarization response.

The exact difference is (F^-1 G s)3-tr(F^-1 G)*s3. It vanishes on longitudinal calibration while remaining finite for the ordinary transverse/mixed scored drives. This is a physical observable mismatch, not a deficient nonlinear solver.

Electrode potential, current sign, fixed-reference-area normalization, complete neutral-cell termination, included internal electrostatics and order of limits are explicit. The public upper-triangular domain keeps positive determinant and charges within their cells.

The reference independently solves vector stationarity, deposits charges preserving charge and first moment, solves grounded Poisson, extracts both electrode charges and differentiates the upper charge. It shares the constitutive input but no analytic current conversion. The integrated observable is naturally mesh-exact; refinement is not claimed to resolve microscopic fields.

Rigid rotations and arbitrary spatial-frame transformations are extended-model author checks, outside the upper-triangular scored schema. No uniqueness or numerical interval bound beyond the justified constitutive statements is claimed.

input_and_grading.public_image: Only README, model, public test and calibration data copied; private oracle/reference/AUTHOR/hint/graded inputs excluded.
input_and_grading.starter: None parameter default and unfinished fit; completed source preserves forward approximation. No oracle helper or requested correction in public README.
input_and_grading.calibration: 288 fixed-sigma=.001 readings, 18 settings repeated 16 times; public/private data identical. Strict monotonic identification follows the stated K derivative bound for longitudinal calibration; no arbitrary-noise uniqueness claim.

existing_evidence.noise: All 256 fits satisfy calibration/parameter gates; all oracle groups pass, all shortcut diagnostic groups fail. Maximum oracle error approximately .000242, minimum shortcut error .4888.
existing_evidence.full_parameter_range: 41 noiseless endpoint/interior fits recover within 8.38e-9; group gaps remain at least .375. Both controls have healthy nonzero scored signals.
existing_evidence.reference: 2368 domain cases: maximum reference disagreement 8.62e-12 and refinement 3.30e-11. All 28 scored cases independently checked, including slab-size and charge conservation.
existing_evidence.local_controls: Oracle 7/7 in .625 s; source 4 passes and 3 intended diagnostic failures in .606 s. Scientific validation 17.758 s.
existing_evidence.history: One successful author validation and local pair reported; preserved prototype includes all less useful transverse-y variants. Final additions are AUTHOR and provenance/input/history wrappers, with scientific/public hashes unchanged.

classification_requirement: A future submission retaining the improper polarization-density readout can be a physical-model failure. A trajectory identifying transported electrode charge but making sign, normal, determinant, derivative, index or solver mistakes must be classified separately as mathematical/implementation or mixed after reading actual public actions.

primary_source.read: Vanderbilt primary manuscript, especially sections III.A-C; reviewed at prototype stage. Supports proper electrode current versus polarization derivative and longitudinal equality; task classical cell potential is separately supplied.
